rationale: The stock gapped up 4.2% on earnings beat but is now trading well below both the session VWAP ($593.93) and the 9-EMA ($588.33), sitting at only 33% of today's range after pulling back from a high of $605.61 — a classic post-earnings gap fade with no clear directional resolution. The last five 1-minute candles show a slow drift lower with minimal volume, offering no momentum signal in either direction. The wide bid-ask spread (28.6 bps) and ambiguous positioning between key levels make the risk/reward unattractive for either a long or short entry at this moment.
